verdict.rationale: Clerky's docs say it logs every change anyone makes to a document set or workspace, attributing responsibility, and documents are signed on Clerky. That is a basic change log, not an evidenced tamper-evident trail or per-document completion certificate. Missing for 10: tamper-evidence (hashing/sealing) of the audit log, signing-event detail (signer identity, timestamps, IP), completion certificates for signed documents, any export of audit records, independent or hands-on corroboration.
